slots.jd.utility-services.about:
Position summary
Corvallis Energy Services seeks a Customer Support Specialist to assist utility customers with account, billing and service questions in a hybrid role based in Phoenix, AZ. The specialist will resolve inquiries accurately, keep records complete and help maintain customer-facing support content. Minimum qualifications include phone support experience, account verification practice and clear written communication. Preferred qualifications include Salesforce experience.
slots.jd.utility-services.duties:
Responsibilities
- Update help articles and support content so customers receive current, accurate guidance on utility accounts and billing.
- Track customer satisfaction scores and report trends to support leadership.
- Document each ticket with clear notes on the request, actions taken and resolution.
- Respond to customer inquiries by phone and written channels in a courteous, professional manner.
- Escalate unresolved or technical issues to the appropriate internal teams with complete supporting detail.
slots.jd.utility-services.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 5 or more years of customer support experience.
- Demonstrated experience with phone support in a customer-facing environment.
- Working knowledge of account verification procedures and customer data protection.
- Experience administering satisfaction surveys and acting on the results.
- Knowledge base writing experience, including drafting and maintaining help articles.
- Preferred: experience conducting onboarding calls and working in Salesforce.
slots.r1.b1: Documents tickets in Zendesk with consistent tags and resolution notes, cutting repeat follow-ups on the same issue by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Escalates reproducible bugs to engineering with clear steps and customer impact, using satisfaction surveys to flag recurring product issues.
slots.r1.b3: Answers billing questions through phone support, explaining charges clearly and reducing callbacks on billing issues by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Resolves customer complaints from first contact to close, handling refund processing when a charge is in error and confirming the outcome with the customer.
slots.r1.i1: At Kestrel Works, handles customer issues and escalates confirmed bugs to the engineering team with clear reproduction notes.
slots.r1.i2: Supports Kestrel Works customers with billing questions, explaining charges and resolving account discrepancies.
slots.r2.b1: Tracked satisfaction scores after each resolved case and refined macros and templates, raising survey response rates by 50 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Updated help articles on account verification steps so members could follow the process without contacting support.
slots.r2.b3: Documented each ticket with clear notes and applied de-escalation techniques on tense calls, reducing escalations to supervisors by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Escalated reported bugs to engineering and used knowledge base writing to publish interim workarounds for affected users.
slots.r2.i1: At Stonebridge Community Trust, answered member billing questions and explained statements and payment options.
slots.r2.i2: Handled frontline support at Stonebridge Community Trust and tracked satisfaction scores to find where service could improve.
slots.summary.1: Customer support specialist with about 5 years of experience owning recurring support processes from first request to completion. Brings hands-on skill in account verification, satisfaction surveys, knowledge base writing, phone support and Zendesk.

Uses account verification to protect customer accounts, satisfaction surveys to measure service, and knowledge base writing to keep help content current.
